name: Cleveland Truck Manufacturing Plant - Cleveland NC

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main controlled entrance on Statesville Blvd (US-70) at a signalized intersection, with a 'DAIMLER TRUCK' canopy gateway structure over a divided entry drive. Campus fully fenced (continuous chain-link confirmed in multiple Street Views along the road frontage).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No discrete 1-3-vehicle guard booth visible at the canopy entrance in satellite or Street View; entrance is a canopy/gateway-sign structure, so a staffed booth could not be confirmed - treated as remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because a controlled gate exists but no guard shack was confirmed; could be a staffed booth obscured by the canopy - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dozens of trailers backed against multiple building faces (N and interior court); easily 50+ doors across the campus.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large dedicated trailer drop yard in the NW with hundreds of trailers in long rows; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count from N drop-yard imagery (~320 trailers visible across rows and dock faces).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs along the NW edge into the trailer-storage strip.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building campus: main assembly building, paint/body buildings, and a separate trailer-yard outbuilding.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts docks (interior court / N face) are physically separate from finished-vehicle outbound flow (S/E finished-truck lots).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small town of Cleveland NC surrounded by farmland; rural setting despite the large industrial footprint.
